title: A price sensor in a minor unit (öre, cent, c, p) reaches the plan at 100x: the 1/100 is never applied
claim: inputs.normalize_price_per_kwh returns value*per_kwh for every unit in PRICE_MINOR_UNITS, so prices_from_entity_attributes publishes an öre/kWh or c/kWh series as major currency per kWh, 100x too high (and an öre/MWh one 100x too high too).
mechanism: inputs.py:791-792: the minor-unit branch returns value*per_kwh where its own docstring (and tests/features.py _P8_FACTORS) says a minor unit is a hundredth of the major one; price_model.prices_from_entity_attributes scales every row by normalize_price_per_kwh(1.0, unit) before VAT and surcharge, and the coordinator plans, publishes and books on those rows. The unit is recognised, so the price_unit_unrecognised notice never fires: silent.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: up to three seats share the box; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb minor: normalize_price_per_kwh divides a minor-unit result by 100 (the documented factor)

metric_definition: unit_mismatches = units of the price grammar where prices_from_entity_attributes' total != raw value * true unit factor * VAT + surcharge (14 units tried)
phenomenon_property: Every price an entity publishes in a minor currency unit reaches the plan, the published costs and the ledger as major currency per kWh: value/100 per the unit's energy factor.

null_control.value: 0 mismatches on SEK/kWh, EUR/MWh, €/kWh, kr/kWh, NOK/Wh and unit-less
null_control.note: the major-unit arms of the same seam are exact; only the 8 minor-unit spellings fail (öre/kWh 153.8 vs 1.638 at VAT 1.25 + 0.1)

reproduction_steps: run the command; read the CELL currency-pv-export price_source=entity line
proposed_fix_scope: inputs.normalize_price_per_kwh: the minor-unit branch returns value*per_kwh/100; tests/features.py's _P8_FACTORS check already states the contract
